concept.title: Optical transceiver modules (illustrative)
concept.shortdesc: A pluggable optical transceiver turns the electrical signals on a host board into light for a fiber link, and back. This topic uses an original 3D model of an OSFP-style module to show its parts.

data.name: licence
data.value: Original text and 3D model. Facts from the OSFP MSA announcement.

conbody.p: OSFP stands for Octal Small Form Factor Pluggable. The OSFP MSA group announced the form factor in March 2017 for 400G optics, with eight electrical lanes, and designed it to carry 800G modules as lane speeds rose.

conbody.note: The model is an original, generic design for illustration. It is not a Google part or any vendor's product.
